verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents diff inspection through code-diff Artifacts and a Review Changes diff viewer, and the agent halts for explicit approval before applying changes. Checks can be run by delegating tests to subagents or through hooks that execute shell commands. However, nothing documents a pre-merge gate or a PR/merge review workflow that ties diffs and check results together before merging. missing for 10: documented merge/PR review gating, integrated display of check/test results alongside diffs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff-review and test-running flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Artifacts include rich markdown plans (Implementation Plans), code diffs, architecture diagrams, images, and browser recordings.
Added a "Hide Whitespace Changes" option to the Review Changes overflow menu and file diff viewers to filter out whitespace-only edits.
The agent always halts and requests your explicit approval before proceeding with proposed changes.
